bullets: In Chennai, a vehicle caught fire on a Velachery road, requiring the office to monitor local safety updates and traffic conditions closely.
In Puducherry, a rangoli competition for college students was held under the Swachh Bharat Mission Urban 2.0 at the Kamban Kalaiarangam campus.

The Greater Chennai Corporation identified 219 vulnerable locations, including low-lying areas and OMR and ECR stretches, ahead of the Northeast monsoon, prompting the office to monitor flood preparedness.
GCC Commissioner G.S. oversaw the identification of these vulnerable spots to ensure readiness, and the office should watch for further monsoon mitigation updates.
